python3 - <<'PY'
import json, sys
with open(sys.argv[1]) as f:
    data = json.load(f)
default_branch = data['repository']['default_branch']
protected_ref = f"refs/heads/{default_branch}"
force = any(p.get('forced') and p.get('ref') == protected_ref for p in data.get('push_events', []))
sys.exit(1 if force else 0)
PY "$GITHUB_EVENT_PATH"
